nodes.name: Games
nodes.description: Structured play with rules, encompassing digital, board, and tabletop forms as creative media.

nodes.name: Video Games
nodes.description: Electronic games played on computers, consoles, and mobile devices.

nodes.name: Action Game
nodes.description: Game centered on physical challenges, reflexes, and combat.

nodes.name: Platformer
nodes.description: Action game of jumping between platforms and obstacles.

nodes.name: Shooter
nodes.description: Action game centered on ranged combat, first- or third-person.

nodes.name: Fighting Game
nodes.description: One-on-one combat game of learned moves and combos.

nodes.name: Beat 'em Up
nodes.description: Side-scrolling combat against waves of enemies.

nodes.name: Adventure Game
nodes.description: Story-driven game centered on exploration and puzzle-solving.

nodes.name: Role-Playing Game
nodes.description: Game of character progression, story, and statistical systems.

nodes.name: Action RPG
nodes.description: RPG blending real-time combat with character progression.

nodes.name: MMORPG
nodes.description: Massively multiplayer online role-playing game.
nodes.name_zh: 大型多人在线角色扮演游戏

nodes.name: Roguelike
nodes.description: Game of procedural generation and permanent death descended from Rogue.

nodes.name: Strategy Game
nodes.description: Game of planning and resource management to achieve objectives.

nodes.name: Real-Time Strategy
nodes.description: Strategy game played in continuous time without turns.

nodes.name: Turn-Based Strategy
nodes.description: Strategy game resolving actions in alternating turns.

nodes.name: Simulation Game
nodes.description: Game modeling real-world systems and activities.

nodes.name: Sports Game
nodes.description: Game simulating real-world sports.

nodes.name: Racing Game
nodes.description: Game centered on competitive vehicle racing.

nodes.name: Puzzle Game
nodes.description: Game centered on logical and spatial problem-solving.

nodes.name: Sandbox Game
nodes.description: Open-ended game granting freedom to create and explore.

nodes.name: Survival Game
nodes.description: Game of resource gathering and endurance in hostile environments.

nodes.name: Battle Royale
nodes.description: Last-person-standing game of shrinking arenas.

nodes.name: Metroidvania
nodes.description: Exploration platformer with interconnected maps and gated abilities.

nodes.name: Visual Novel
nodes.description: Interactive fiction driven by text, images, and branching choices.

nodes.name: Board Games
nodes.description: Tabletop games played on a board with pieces.

nodes.name: Abstract Strategy Game
nodes.description: Board game of pure strategy with no theme or chance.

nodes.name: Chess
nodes.description: The classic two-player game of strategy played on 64 squares.

nodes.name: Go
nodes.description: East Asian territorial game played with black and white stones.

nodes.name: Shogi
nodes.description: Japanese chess with drop rules allowing captured pieces to re-enter play.

nodes.name: Xiangqi
nodes.description: Chinese chess played on an intersecting-line board with a river.

nodes.name: Eurogame
nodes.description: Strategy board game emphasizing resource management and indirect conflict.

nodes.name: Wargame
nodes.description: Board game simulating military conflict.

nodes.name: Party Game
nodes.description: Light social game for large groups.

nodes.name: Card Games
nodes.description: Games played with a deck of cards.

nodes.name: Collectible Card Game
nodes.description: Card game built around collecting and deck-building.

nodes.name: Playing Card Games
nodes.description: Traditional games using a standard deck of cards.

nodes.name: Tabletop Role-Playing Game
nodes.description: Collaborative storytelling game governed by dice and rules.

nodes.name: Game Design
nodes.description: The craft of designing game rules, systems, and experiences.

nodes.name: Game Art
nodes.description: The visual art of games, including characters, environments, and UI.

nodes.name: Concept Art
nodes.description: Preliminary art establishing a game's visual direction.

nodes.name: Game Music
nodes.description: Music composed for video games, often adaptive to play.
